scorer: pre-outcome pick_team + score_gw: legal XI/bench/captain/vice from as-of signal only; official auto-subs (bench order, formation legal, GK-for-GK) and vice-captain on realized minutes; full player-GW scoring

panel.current_season_source: official FPL API (bootstrap-static, element-summary, fixtures); vaastav 2026-27 covers only through GW6 at pinned master, insufficient for GW10 trailing-4 features
panel.note: csv_sha256 and pulled_at are filled at the data freeze after GW9 completes and before the GW10 deadline; that data snapshot is part of the freeze plan, not a spec change

scoring_rule: Score each completed GW (all fixtures finished, official points incl. bonus final) by deterministic replay of the frozen policies from GW10; per-GW points = cumulative(K) - cumulative(K-1). No spec or code edits after the freeze; any spec change restarts the clock and is recorded here.
known_simplifications: buys pay the target-GW deadline price (intra-week moves unmodelled)
buy candidates must be panel-present (4 trailing GW rows, >=180 trailing minutes) - eligibility bias toward established regulars
chips (WC/FH/BB/TC) are not modelled in this simulation

decision_freeze.protocol: Before each GW K deadline, `freeze --gw K --spec <this spec>` persists each policy's actual decisions (starting squad at start_gw, transfers with prices used, XI, bench order, captain/vice) into 12th-man/v2/data/frozen/decisions/gw<K>-<version>.json with frozen_at, input hashes (played-rows csv_sha256, schedule rows, bootstrap now_cost sha256 + pull time) and code blob pins. Frozen files are NEVER overwritten; corrections require a new label, not an edit. `score-gw --gw K` later applies official actuals (bonus-final, GW complete in provenance) to the frozen decisions only, appending to the version-labelled results file; re-scoring a GW is refused.
decision_freeze.decision_inputs: strictly pre-outcome: played rows with gw < K; fixture SCHEDULE at K (opponents known pre-deadline); bootstrap now_cost at frozen_at; prior frozen decision files. No GW-K outcome rows are required or used; decision_sql_for reproduces the frozen panel's feature semantics on schedule-anchored rows (equivalence enforced by tests/test_prospective_decisions.py on completed GWs).
decision_freeze.decision_code: transfer decisions use bt.transfer_week, the identical code path as the replay (extracted from simulate() 31 Oct; behavior-preserving, verified by byte-identical replay output against the pre-refactor script on both holdout seasons).
decision_freeze.replay_label: `replay` (formerly `run`) reconstructs choices AFTER outcome rows exist and is a DIAGNOSTIC only; outputs land in prospective-2026-27-replay*.json, never in the prospective record.
decision_freeze.immutability: freeze refuses to overwrite an existing decision file; score-gw refuses to re-score a GW already in the results file; every decision file carries a content_sha256 self-hash verified at load.

pre_freeze_revisions: 2026-10-31 (pre-data-freeze): added the forward decision-freeze protocol (decision_freeze block) and relabeled run->replay as diagnostic; code pins updated for the transfer_week extraction + freeze/score-gw runner commands. Policy definitions, panel semantics, scorer and budget/FT parameters UNCHANGED; both specs were pre-data-freeze (csv_sha256 null), so the prospective clock had not started and no frozen output existed.
